facts.source_fact: A temporary change to monitoring methodology must be notified 14 days before it occurs, or as soon as reasonably practicable if advance notice is impossible.
Tier-threshold exceedance or equipment non-conformity requiring corrective action must be notified on the same timing basis.
Measurement equipment being out of operation must be notified on the same timing basis.
A hospital-service HSE that stops primarily providing services to a hospital must notify the regulator by 31 March in the following year.
A small-emitter HSE whose reportable emissions exceed 24,999 tCO2e must notify the regulator by 31 March in the following year.
A proposed modified plan may be used before approval if following the current plan would lead to incomplete emissions data.
Where the current plan would produce incomplete data, monitoring and reporting must use both the current and proposed plans.
All monitoring under both plans must be documented until the regulator approves the modification.
Applications, reports and notifications are submitted through METS unless the regulator agrees otherwise.
Notifications do not themselves constitute regulator approval of a change.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer approval from notification.
